Revision 144 | Coordinator: /root | Latest complete matrix remains v218: 1/32 cells and 399/432 checks passed. The next full matrix remains unstarted. G6-054 stays parked.
The complete native binding batch is implemented and independently verified in its stated scope. All 163 targeted checks passed: 55 Python, 108 Node, plus formatting. All original test processes joined and source stayed unchanged. The prior 161/163 run remains failed; its two new test fixtures were repaired without production changes or deleted assertions. One now distinguishes normal and boundary contradiction paths; the other awaits actual simulated capture/ontrack before activation.
V219-RETIREMENT-BINDING — Owner: media_blockers; native serializer: v198_resources; independent reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. This task now covers both activation and retirement. Actual prior 449 statistics had a 376–556 ms tail before old-owner retirement and a 446–628 ms head after target publication. The new fixture records typed native binding facts once at the validated public switch and once at first native close. It preserves the original immediate close, capture promise, media graph and authorization behavior; it adds no periodic native statistics read or packet-path permission check.
The exact sender track is pinned only after original capture succeeds. A bounded per-observer weak registry supplies the exact receiver stream/track at the validated cut before snapshot and render. Native pointer/MID, actual selected ICE endpoints, codec declarations, sender SSRC and conservative receiver RTP-coordinate bounds supplement a missing sample endpoint. At least one real opposite RTP sample and all available contradictions remain mandatory. Public ownership, same owner/track/element, unique Core epoch and complete closed packet/frame bijection remain unchanged.
The actual serializer also passed an independently reviewed pinned-Firefox capability run: two warm bidirectional native peers negotiated with null sender tracks, then attached real tracks. All four tags and eight public/terminal direction bindings completed. Ended sender tracks, cached single public captures, immediate duplicate close, released native references and natural original browser/Node shutdown were verified. This is API capability evidence, not Connect authorization, media quality or Core/packet association. The first one-way probe remains failed; correcting its answering transceiver setup required no production change.
The earlier main profile 2 batch remains verified: complete row/alias census, separate send/receive public ledgers, source-only whole-frame loss detection, exact indexed epoch ranges and mandatory passive wire control even with zero aliases. Bounds remain 8 MiB per-cycle witness, 32 MiB private cycle JSON, 96 MiB aggregate original-cycle scope and 512 MiB offline index/proof under the original 30-second deadline. Raw quality limits and historical results are unchanged.
Next: commit this reviewed checkpoint and run the prepared normal three-cycle local Firefox programme, with normal completion delivery and audio debug off. It must pass actual native/Core/closed-wire alias and passive proofs, media quality, resources and all original closures. Then complete the current full regression, local ARM source preparation/tests, normal release checks and final preflight before reporting ready for 32. No full 32 run begins during this preparation phase.
